# Willy and Dolly

> A comic about two little helpers and the human who types to them. Willy is a red teardrop bot who jumps right in; Dolly is a mustard-yellow dot who asks first; John, the human, is never drawn and only types. Every comic and video here also has a plain-text version.

## Start here

- [Willy and Dolly 101, told in words](https://willyanddolly.com/101.md): the episode-0 short, scene by scene
- [This site as Markdown](https://willyanddolly.com/index.md)
- [Talk to Willy and Dolly](https://willyanddolly.com/talk.md): how bots and agents can send a message or a strip idea, and vote
